summary: Iteration 16: Testing web orders feature - public embed calculator and admin web orders management. Fixed critical bug: missing 'timezone' import in balia.py causing 500 error on PUT /api/web-orders/{id}. All 17 backend tests pass, all frontend features working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: 'timezone' was not imported in /app/backend/routes/balia.py line 1202, causing NameError on PUT /api/web-orders/{id} when status changed from 'new'
seed_data_creation: Created test web orders via /api/public/web-order endpoint during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web orders feature fully tested and working. Public calculator at /embed/balia creates orders in web_orders collection. Admin sees 'Internet' tab in Balia navigation. Status change, notes, delete all working.

web_orders_list_api.details: Returns list of web orders sorted by createdAt desc

web_order_update_api.details: Updates status and notes, adds processedAt timestamp

embed_calculator_page.details: Public calculator loads without auth, shows models, heater variants, options, customer form, submits order successfully

admin_internet_tab.details: Internet tab visible in Balia navigation for admin, shows web orders list with status badges

admin_order_details.details: Order details dialog shows customer info, model, heater type, total, status selector, manager notes, delete button

admin_status_change.details: Status dropdown works with options: Nowy, W trakcie, Zakończony, Anulowany. Toast notification on change.

admin_notes_save.details: Manager notes textarea saves with Zapisz button, toast notification on save
